verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any natural-language command interface in Stripe Billing itself, such as a Dashboard assistant or a conversational CLI. The official MCP server lets external AI agents call the Stripe API, but the natural-language interpretation happens in a third-party agent. That makes it an adjacent capability belonging to the separate MCP-server story, so it earns no credit here. The CLI and the llms.txt / markdown docs are likewise developer building blocks, not natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
